company.description: Gym Class is a virtual reality basketball app available on Meta Quest App Lab. It combines the enjoyment, fitness, socialization, and entertainment aspects of real-world sports in VR basketball. Gym Class, which uses physics and high-fidelity graphics, includes realistic basketball mechanics, full-body avatars, and immersive environments. Players from all over the world can connect and play basketball games on a customizable digital court, as well as socialize.
